name: Asad Ali

about: Senior Technical Lead with 14+ years architecting and scaling full-stack platforms across Node.js/TypeScript, Python (Django) and PHP/Laravel. Currently at PlanLeft, leading full-stack delivery across WordPress, Drupal and Laravel plus AI-assisted builds on Lovable and Supabase, and owning server infrastructure across DigitalOcean, Laravel Forge, AWS and Cloudways. I recently built an AI-powered ad-generation product from the ground up — multi-model orchestration, agent pipelines, RAG and a vector-database embedding system — through to its Product Hunt launch. I've led engineering departments of 50+ developers while staying hands-on with architecture, code quality and CI/CD, and I specialise in high-availability e-commerce systems handling six-figure daily sales.
